job.title: Sales Consultants
job.description:
Sales Consultants WANTED

This is not just a job. This is an opportunity that offers a lucrative career path with an uncapped earning potential of $200,000 to $350,000+ to top performers and join an elite sales team in a consulting firm experiencing explosive growth!

�� The Rewards & Earning Potential
  • Strong Financial Baseline: $70K–$90K base salary + superannuation.
  • Realistic Year 1 OTE: $100K–$160K, driven by a highly achievable 6-month quota ramp-up.
  • Uncapped Upside: Experienced high performers realistically clear $200K–$350K+.
  • Work-Life Flexibility: Full immersion in our high-energy office for the first 6 months, transitioning to a weekly Work From Home (WFH) day post-probation.
  • Continuous Investment in You: A monthly $30 learning allowance plus elite sales and leadership training to fast-track your progression into future leadership roles.
⚡ The Role: High Activity, High Reward

Sales Consultants will take full ownership of your desk in this fast-paced, phone-based B2B sales role where your hustle directly dictates your pay check.
  • The Pace: Manage a high-volume desk executing 40–60 manual dials per day.
  • The Deal: Target mid-market accounts closing deals in a swift 2+ week sales cycle.
  • The Hunt: Build, manage, and self-source your own pipeline with no restrictive territory boundaries.
�� What You Bring to the Table

We are looking for pure hunters who thrive on the thrill of the chase. You must be comfortable with high-volume outbound activity and possess the resilience required for cold-calling commercial decision-makers.

Must-Haves:
  • Outbound B2B phone sales experience (think inside sales, freight/logistics, tech, media, or energy sectors preferred).
  • A proven, quantifiable track record of driving new business and smashing sales targets.
  • Exceptional verbal communication skills and a resilient, self-motivated mindset.
  • Comfort working in a high-activity, office-based environment.
�� Culture & Environment

We believe in working hard and winning together. You will join a tight-knit squad in a supportive, high-performing environment. Expect strong peer collaboration, genuine camaraderie, and a leadership team genuinely invested in your professional development.

�� Ready to Apply?

We are ready to hire immediately for the right candidate. Interviews start next week and it’s a streamlined and smooth twostep process + reference checks.

Apply NOW to take control of your earning capacity and SET YOURSELF UP FOR LIFE!

job.title: SAP Finance (FICO) Consultant
job.description:
Mayvun Arc Recruitment is seeking an experienced SAP Finance (FICO) Consultant for a global organisation based in Brisbane on an 8+ month contract. We are seeking a candidate with prior divestment or carve-out experience who can operate independently, engage senior stakeholders, and successfully drive finance delivery within a large-scale separation program.

Role Purpose:

Lead the SAP Finance (FICO) workstream for a divestment program, ensuring successful delivery of Finance processes, data, testing, cutover, and readiness.
The role works closely with business stakeholders, project managers, architects, and other functional leads in a complex multi-vendor environment.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Lead end-to-end SAP FICO delivery across design, build, testing, cutover, and hyper care.
  • Own Finance workstream planning, execution, risks, and issue management.
  • Drive stakeholder engagement and facilitate workshops and governance discussions.
  • Coordinate Finance activities across data migration, integration, testing, and reporting teams.
  • Support SIT, UAT, cutover planning, and deployment readiness.
  • Manage offshore delivery teams and ensure delivery quality.
Required Experience:
  • 10+ years SAP FICO experience.
  • Proven leadership of SAP Finance workstreams in carve-out, merger, acquisition, or divestment programs.
  • Strong expertise in:
    • SAP FI/CO
    • GL, AP, AR
    • Asset Accounting
    • Cost Centre Accounting
    • Financial Closing
  • SAP S/4HANA experience preferred.
Key Skills
  • SAP FICO Solution Design
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Program Delivery
  • Data Migration
  • Testing & Cutover
  • Risk & Issue Management
  • Executive Communication
